recipes.literal: JSON null, booleans, strings, safe-integer numbers, arrays and objects are used as written; members may hold recipes
recipes.$decimal: number(token); the result must be a Decimal
recipes.$number: number(token); the result may be a primitive
recipes.$native: a binary64 number literal of the host language
recipes.$base64: base64(bytes) over the listed byte values
recipes.$hex: encoded(bytes, hex) where hex.length is 2 * byteLength and hex.encode is lowercase hexadecimal
recipes.$nest: an array nested n levels deep around 0; $bigDecimal: number('1' followed by n-1 zeros); $base64Zeros: base64 over n zero bytes; $nestedText: [open, n, close] builds open repeated n times, then 1 for objects, then close repeated n times
recipes.typescript-only: $undefined, $function, $symbol, $bigint, $nan, $infinity, $negzero, $accessor, $cycle, $host, $rawjson, $foreignDecimal, $hole, $extra, $nullproto, $toJSON; the string "$loneSurrogate" stands for U+D800 followed by x, which JSON tooling and Go strings cannot carry

witnesses.number: a primitive number equal to the literal (-0 is never accepted)
witnesses.$decimal: a Decimal whose digits are exactly the token
witnesses.$base64: an Encoded whose encoding is BASE64 and whose bytes() equal the list
witnesses.$hex: an Encoded whose encoding is not BASE64, whose bytes() equal the list, and whose forced string is the hexadecimal text
witnesses.containers: structural; object key sets must match; member order is not asserted

expect.encodes | bytesEncoded | bytesCopied | s: the exact delta of that counter across the operation
expect.details: a subset of details of the thrown ValueError
expect.messageIncludes | messageExcludes: a substring test on the thrown message

notation.languages: absent means every language; ["typescript"] means the recipe or observable is host-specific
